/ error pages: the sign over the night of ink (direction Z) — one thought from the worldview cut into three tubes, two lit and the third never lit, over a WebGL night that pours every block's hash as what it is: 256 bits in a 16 × 16 grid of ink (1 jade, 0 violet) that holds for a second, then dissolves in a current the hash itself seeded; the 1-bits leave as motes whose short trails are the one sharp line over the soft ink. Route: \"all that is / was worked for. / this was not.\"; entity known as something else (a verified /search alternative): \"a hash / is a fact. / a name, a guess.\"; entity nothing answers: \"known to some, / perhaps. / to all, not yet.\"; a page that fell: \"the chain keeps / what succeeded. / this did not.\" (brownout). The sign is quiet — the night leads: no white-hot core, the lit lines at ~70 % with a 12 px halo, 52 / 40 / 28 px by width, sizes in CSS. The facts stay the honest tier bottom-left: the exact checked endpoint and identifier, the /search finding and alternative, the error in red with page · network · build and \"the chain was not checked in this view\"; a route 404 pours no hash until the realtime feed delivers a block (\"the chain was not asked\"), an entity page pours the hash it was asked for first. (1) lib/night: bits (the 256 bits of a hash, the grid geometry), field (a curl of value noise baked to 128 × 64 per block, two fields blended over 3 s, one CPU sampler that matches the shader), gl (shaders and helpers; the ink and the trails are RGBA16F — an 8-bit buffer cannot fade at 0.9975 per frame; decay and advection scaled by dt), motes (only the 1-bits leave, sixteen blocks kept), night (createNight: ink step, stamp, motes, trails, show; context lost → the page's CSS night, restored → rebuilt; the context released after 1.5 s off screen and taken back; a still frame under reduced motion; stop() frees the GL objects but keeps the context, because React's strict effects and a resize remount on the same canvas); (2) hooks/useNight mounts it, pours the page's hash first (or the tip the feed already holds), every new block after, rebuilds on a settled width change; (3) components/error-night (the canvas; the CSS night — the same grid as 256 DOM squares, a wash, the afterglow — while it cannot run), error-sign (warm-up tube by tube, a flicker 300 ms after a block, the eggs: tap a lit line for the next reading, hold the dark line two seconds for the inversion that turns the night rose, an epoch turn lights the dark line once, \"tap or hover\" from the shared hint), error-page-shell (sign + night + facts, the shared .eyebrow with \"You are (not) here\" under the pointer; provider-safe: the static CSS night), not-found-page and crash-page on it. Deleted: the vessel artwork (components/error-vessels, lib/error-vessels, hooks/useErrorVessels), the API route /vessels/snapshot with its integration test, the vessel types and client method, the MSW handler and fixture, the Noto Serif Display font with its @font-face and --font-error-display.
